info.title: Zoho Analytics API
info.description: API for Reports and Dashboards in Zoho Analytics - covering the creation, update and metadata retrieval of analysis views, and the listing, creation, metadata retrieval and update of dashboards.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description:
APIs for creating a report (chart, pivot or summary view) on an existing table, reading the stored definition back, and rebuilding it. A report is also called a visual, an analysis view or simply a view in API responses and error messages.

A report is defined almost entirely by its drop fields - the `axisColumns` array, where each entry says which column goes on which shelf with which operation; filters, user filters, window functions and formatting hang off that core. The three endpoints are not available on white-label / custom domains, and Update is a full replacement, never a patch.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: APIs for creating a dashboard, reading its stored layout, settings and themes, replacing any of those three sections, and listing the dashboards a user owns or can see. A dashboard is a canvas of cards on a fixed 80-unit-wide grid; `layout` travels as a JSON-encoded string on write and comes back as an object on read. Tabbed dashboards cannot be managed through these APIs (7511).

post.description:
Builds a new chart, pivot or summary view on an existing table and returns its view ID.

Permission required: Workspace Admin / Organization Admin, or a shared or group user holding Create Report permission on the base table.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> This API is not available on white-label / custom domains. Call the standard REST host for your data centre (**analyticsapi.zoho.com**, **analyticsapi.zoho.eu**, ...).

> Note:
>
> Axis **type** values are returned in lowercase (**xaxis**, **yaxis**, **coloraxis**, **textaxis**, **groupby**, **tooltip**, **latlng**) whatever casing was sent; all of those are accepted on write. A **tooltip** column may be returned as **group**, which Create and Update reject with 8509.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 8504 | baseTableName is absent, or the CONFIG parameter itself is missing. | Send CONFIG with baseTableName. |
| 7138 | baseTableName does not resolve to a table in this workspace. | Use the exact table display name. |
| 7016 | title is empty or whitespace-only. | Supply a non-empty title. |
| 7111 | A view with this title already exists in the workspace. | Choose a unique title. |
| 8507 | title exceeds 100 characters, description exceeds 250, or an axis displayName exceeds 250. | Shorten the value. |
| 8252 | reportType is absent or null. | Supply chart, pivot or summary. |
| 8092 | reportType resolves to a view kind that cannot be saved standalone. | Use chart, pivot or summary. |
| 8144 | chartType is not a recognised chart name. | See Appendix A. |
| 8147 | settings was supplied for a non-pivot report. | Remove settings, or change reportType to pivot. |
| 7362 | folderId does not exist in the workspace. | Supply a valid folder ID or omit the key. |
| 8051 | A required field is missing — title, reportType, axisColumns, or a mandatory key inside an axis/filter object. | Add the missing field. |
| 8050 | A value is invalid — unknown columnName, an operation incompatible with the column, a null axisColumns. | Check column names and operations. |
| 8052 | More than 1000 entries in axisColumns, filters or userFilters. | Reduce the array size. |
| 8170 | An axis type is not valid for the chosen reportType. | See Appendix B. |
| 7701 | A chart report has no X-axis or no Y-axis column. | Add at least one of each. |
| 7703 | A colorAxis column is present alongside more than one Y-axis column. | Drop the colour axis, or reduce to one Y axis. |
| 7727 | More than 15 Y-axis columns on a chart. | Reduce to 15 or fewer. |
| 8021 | The pivot or summary structure is invalid — no data column in a pivot, too many data or groupBy columns, or a column in a position its type cannot occupy. On Update, also raised when reportType does not match the stored view's type. | Review the axis configuration. |
| 8166 | The operation is incompatible with the column's data type. | See Appendix C. |
| 8167 | The filterType is not valid for the column type + operation combination. | See Appendix D. |
| 8168 | A values entry does not match the expected format for the filterType. | See Appendix E. |
| 8191 | An invalid date value was supplied to a date filter. | Use the documented date formats. |
| 8057 | The column named in windowFunction.baseField cannot be used as a base field here. | Choose a different reference column. |
| 8059 | The tableName is not part of the workspace or is not joined to the base table. | Use a table reachable through the join graph. |
| 8162 | rangeSize was supplied as a string, or on an operation that does not support ranges. | Send a JSON number, and only with range grouping. |
| 8516 | rangeSize was supplied as an array. | Send a plain number. |
| 8250 | compType is not applicable to the column category — e.g. slider on a dimension, singleSelect on a measure. | Match the widget to the column type. |
| 8253 | A mandatory userFilters key is missing, typically compType or filterType. | Add the missing key. |
| 8008 | behaviour was supplied on a daterange or relative user filter. | Remove behaviour. |
| 8254 | A geoRole value is wrong for the column type. | latitude/longitude for numeric columns; place roles for text columns. |
| 8255 | geoRole was supplied on a column that cannot be geocoded. | Remove geoRole, or use a geocodable column. |
| 8256 | More than one geo operation on the same axis. | Keep one geo column per axis. |
| 8257 | A numeric geo column coexists with a categorical geo column. | Use one or the other. |
| 8258 | A categorical geo column was placed on an axis other than X. | Move it to xAxis. |
| 8509 | An enumerated or pattern-constrained value does not match — reportType: "Chart" (must be lowercase), type: "sizeAxis" (must be sizeaxis), sort: "descending", a wildcard expression without parentheses. | Use the exact accepted values. |
| 8517 | A field has the wrong JSON data type — exclude: "yes", isAxisMerge: "maybe", compType: 123. | Use real JSON booleans and strings. |
| 8534 | CONFIG is malformed, or a key has the wrong structural type — axisColumns as {}, mergeAxisInfo as an object, values as a bare string. | Arrays must be [], objects {}. |
| 8542 | An unknown key is present in CONFIG, or a windowFunction is mis-configured. | Remove the key; check windowFunction.type against the list. |
| 7005 | A null element inside axisColumns or filters. | Ensure every array element is a JSON object. |
| 7301 | The caller lacks Create Report permission on the workspace. | Grant the permission. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Refresh with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.create. |

get.description:
Returns the stored definition of a chart, pivot or summary view.

Permission required: Design Modify on the report. A read-only shared user cannot call this endpoint.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> This is a workspace-scoped API. The **ZANALYTICS-ORGID** header carrying the organization ID that owns the workspace is mandatory.

> Note:
>
> This API is not available on white-label / custom domains. Call the standard REST host for your data centre (**analyticsapi.zoho.com**, **analyticsapi.zoho.eu**, ...).

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7104 | The report does not exist or has been deleted. | Verify . |
| 7106 | The report does not exist or has been deleted. | Verify . |
| 7319 | The report belongs to a different workspace. | Make the two path IDs consistent. |
| 8021 | The target is not a chart, pivot or summary view. | Use a report ID, not a table or dashboard. |
| 7301 | The caller lacks Design Modify permission on the report. | Grant edit access. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Refresh with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.read. |

get.description:
Returns all dashboards accessible to the authenticated user - both those owned by the user and those shared with them - across every organization and workspace. The response groups the results into two separate lists, `ownedViews` and `sharedViews`.

This API has no request parameters; all context is derived from the OAuth token. The authenticated user may be any active Zoho Analytics user.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> Get Shared Dashboards is available on custom domains. Get All Dashboards and Get Owned Dashboards are disabled on custom domains. The workspace-scoped dashboard APIs are accessible on custom domains subject to additional permission checks.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7301 | User does not have permission to retrieve dashboards. | Ensure the request uses a valid OAuth token for an active Zoho Analytics user. |
| 8535 | Invalid OAuth token. | Provide a valid, non-expired OAuth token in the Authorization header. |

200.description: The list of dashboards was retrieved successfully.

ownedAndShared.description: The user owns two dashboards and has one more shared with them.

ownedViews.viewDesc: High-level sales KPIs for the executive team

ownedOnly.description: The user owns one dashboard and nothing has been shared with them, so sharedViews comes back empty.

ownedViews.viewDesc: High-level sales KPIs for the executive team

noDashboards.description: The user has no dashboards at all and both lists come back empty.

get.description:
Returns the list of dashboards owned by the authenticated user across every organization, as a single `views` array.

This API has no request parameters; all context is derived from the OAuth token. The authenticated user must be an Account Admin.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> Get Shared Dashboards is available on custom domains. Get All Dashboards and Get Owned Dashboards are disabled on custom domains. The workspace-scoped dashboard APIs are accessible on custom domains subject to additional permission checks.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7301 | User does not have permission to retrieve owned dashboards. | Ensure the authenticated user is an Account Admin. |
| 8535 | Invalid OAuth token. | Provide a valid, non-expired OAuth token in the Authorization header. |

200.description: The list of dashboards was retrieved successfully.

multipleWorkspaces.description: The Account Admin owns dashboards in two different workspaces and organizations.

views.viewDesc: High-level sales KPIs for the executive team

singleDashboard.description: The Account Admin owns one dashboard.

noDashboards.description: The Account Admin owns no dashboards and the list comes back empty.

get.description:
Returns all dashboards that have been shared with the authenticated user across every organization and workspace, as a single `views` array. Unlike Get All Dashboards, this endpoint returns only shared dashboards, and it is also available on custom domains.

This API has no request parameters; all context is derived from the OAuth token. The authenticated user may be any active Zoho Analytics user.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7301 | User does not have permission to retrieve shared dashboards. | Ensure the request uses a valid OAuth token for an active Zoho Analytics user. |
| 8535 | Invalid OAuth token. | Provide a valid, non-expired OAuth token in the Authorization header. |

200.description: The list of dashboards was retrieved successfully.

multipleShared.description: Two dashboards from different organizations have been shared with the user; sharedBy carries the email of each sharer.

favoriteShared.description: One shared dashboard that the requesting user has marked as a favorite.

noDashboards.description: Nothing has been shared with the user and the list comes back empty.

post.description:
Creates a dashboard in the given workspace and returns its ID.

Permission required: Workspace Admin / Organization Admin, or a shared or group user holding Create Report permission on the workspace. A Custom Role user must have the Create Report permission explicitly granted, otherwise the call is rejected before any validation runs.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> Tabbed dashboards are out of scope: Read and Update reject a tabbed dashboard with **7511**.

**Rate limit**

- Up to 10 requests per 60 seconds. Exceeding this blocks further calls for 600 seconds.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7487 | displayName or layout is absent, null or empty. | Supply both. Remember layout is a JSON-encoded string. |
| 7111 | A dashboard with this displayName already exists in the workspace. | Choose a different name. |
| 7507 | displayName exceeds 100 characters, or description exceeds 250. | Shorten the value. |
| 7510 | layout is not parseable JSON, or a themes sub-object is null. | Validate the JSON you embed in the layout string; never send null for card, solid, gradient or image. |
| 7479 | A card is missing one or more of type, width, height, left, top. | Add the missing positional fields. |
| 7486 | A positional field has the wrong JSON type. | width, height, left, top must be integers; type must be a string. |
| 7485 | Unrecognised card type. | Use one of the eight values in Card types. |
| 7480 | Negative offset, width/height of 1 or less, or left + width > 80. | Keep every card inside the 80-unit grid. |
| 7512 | A card is smaller than the minimum for its type. | See the min height/width columns in Card types. |
| 7482 | Two cards overlap. | Reposition so no two rectangles intersect. |
| 7483 | A HTML, TITLE, PARA, IMAGE or EMBED card has absent, null or empty content. | Supply a non-empty content string. |
| 7484 | More than 100 cards in the layout. | Split the dashboard. |
| 8027 | One or more VIEW cards name a view that does not exist in this workspace, or viewName is absent / null / non-string. | Check the view display names. Matching is case-insensitive but the view must exist. |
| 7481 | The referenced view exists but the caller cannot read it. | Have the view shared with the caller, or remove the card. |
| 9001 | Every card in the layout is a USERFILTERS card. | Add at least one content-bearing card. |
| 7491 | The sub-object required by themes.type is missing, or card is absent. | Add the required sub-object. |
| 7492 | A required field inside the type sub-object or inside card is missing. | See the required-fields table in Themes. |
| 7493 | A sub-object belonging to a different theme type is present, or a forbidden key accompanies default. | Remove the conflicting key. |
| 7513 | chartEffect.type supplied while chartEffect.apply is 1. | Remove type, or set apply to 2. |
| 7514 | chartEffect.apply is 2 but chartEffect.type is absent. | Supply chartEffect.type. |
| 7488 | A settings or themes key has an empty or null value, or an unrecognised key reached the server. | Remove the key or give it a valid value. |
| 8509 | An enumerated or pattern-constrained value does not match — a malformed colour, an out-of-range number, layoutType outside 1–4, a non-string colour. | Check the ranges in Themes and Settings. |
| 8517 | A value has the wrong JSON data type for its schema declaration. | Match the declared types. |
| 8534 | A theme sub-object was supplied as an array, or CONFIG is malformed JSON. | Use {} for objects. |
| 8504 | The CONFIG parameter is missing from the request body. | Send CONFIG as a form-encoded parameter. |
| 8542 | An unknown key is present in CONFIG. | Only displayName, description, layout, themes, settings, layoutType are accepted. |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7301 | The caller lacks Create Report permission on the workspace, or is calling from a white-label domain that is not mapped to this workspace. | Grant the permission, or call the standard data-centre domain. |
| 7309 | Authorization header absent. | Send Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken . |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Refresh the token with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.create. |

letTheServerLayTheCardsOutInTwoColumnsOn.description:
Let the server lay the cards out in two columns**

Only the view names matter here; the geometry is replaced.

```http
POST /restapi/v2/workspaces/466206000000071000/dashboards HTTP/1.1
Host: analyticsapi.zoho.com
Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken 1000.xxxxxx.yyyyyy
ZANALYTICS-ORGID: 700000123456
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

CONFIG={"displayName":"Auto Layout","layoutType":2,"layout":"{\"1\":{\"type\":\"VIEW\",\"viewName\":\"Sales Chart\",\"width\":40,\"height\":20,\"left\":0,\"top\":0},\"2\":{\"type\":\"VIEW\",\"viewName\":\"Margin Chart\",\"width\":40,\"height\":20,\"left\":40,\"top\":0}}"}
```

**Case 4 — Gradient theme, as shown in the API reference.

get.description:
Returns the stored configuration of a dashboard. This is the read half of the read-modify-write cycle that Update Dashboard requires.

Permission required: Read Only or higher on the dashboard. Owners, Workspace Admins, Organization Admins, shared users and group members with read access all qualify.

**Rate limit**

- Up to 20 requests per 60 seconds.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7104 | The dashboard does not exist, or is 0. | Verify . |
| 7319 | The dashboard exists but belongs to a different workspace. | Make and consistent. |
| 7511 | The target is a tabbed dashboard. | Tabbed dashboards cannot be read through this API. |
| 7018 | Malformed URL — the ID is not a valid numeric path segment. | Use the numeric dashboard ID only. |
| 8509 | include is not one of all, layout, themes, settings. | Use a single valid section name. |
| 7301 | The caller lacks read permission on the dashboard, or is on an unmapped white-label domain. | Share the dashboard with the caller. |
| 7309 | Authorization header absent. | Send the OAuth header. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Refresh with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.read. |

| 7486 | A positional field has the wrong JSON type. | width, height, left, top must be integers; type must be a string. |
| 7485 | Unrecognised card type. | Use one of the eight values in Card types. |
| 7480 | Negative offset, width/height of 1 or less, or left + width > 80. | Keep every card inside the 80-unit grid. |
| 7512 | A card is smaller than the minimum for its type. | See the min height/width columns in Card types. |
| 7482 | Two cards overlap. | Reposition so no two rectangles intersect. |
| 7483 | A HTML, TITLE, PARA, IMAGE or EMBED card has absent, null or empty content. | Supply a non-empty content string. |
| 7484 | More than 100 cards in the layout. | Split the dashboard. |
| 8027 | One or more VIEW cards name a view that does not exist in this workspace, or viewName is absent / null / non-string. | Check the view display names. Matching is case-insensitive but the view must exist. |
| 7481 | The referenced view exists but the caller cannot read it. | Have the view shared with the caller, or remove the card. |
| 9001 | Every card in the layout is a USERFILTERS card. | Add at least one content-bearing card. |
| 7491 | The sub-object required by themes.type is missing, or card is absent. | Add the required sub-object. |
| 7492 | A required field inside the type sub-object or inside card is missing. | See the required-fields table in Themes. |
| 7493 | A sub-object belonging to a different theme type is present, or a forbidden key accompanies default. | Remove the conflicting key. |
| 7513 | chartEffect.type supplied while chartEffect.apply is 1. | Remove type, or set apply to 2. |
| 7514 | chartEffect.apply is 2 but chartEffect.type is absent. | Supply chartEffect.type. |
| 7488 | A settings or themes key has an empty or null value, or an unrecognised key reached the server. | Remove the key or give it a valid value. |
| 8509 | An enumerated or pattern-constrained value does not match — a malformed colour, an out-of-range number, layoutType outside 1–4, a non-string colour. | Check the ranges in Themes and Settings. |
| 8517 | A value has the wrong JSON data type for its schema declaration. | Match the declared types. |
| 8534 | A theme sub-object was supplied as an array, or CONFIG is malformed JSON. | Use {} for objects. |
| 8504 | The CONFIG parameter is missing from the request body. | Send CONFIG as a form-encoded parameter. |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7309 | Authorization header absent. | Send Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken . |

parameters.description: ID of the workspace that contains the dashboard.

parameters.description: ID of the dashboard to update.

changeOnlyTheTheme.description: Change only the theme, as shown in the API reference.

replaceTheLayout.description: Replace the layout, as shown in the API reference.

resetToTheDefaultTheme.description: Reset to the default theme, as shown in the API reference.

204.description: The dashboard was updated successfully. No response body is returned.

iam-oauth2-schema.description: Authentication is based on OAuth2 flow

scopes.ZohoAnalytics.modeling.read: Read report and dashboard design metadata

AxisColumn.title: AxisColumn
AxisColumn.description: Places one column on one shelf of the report.

type.description: Which shelf the column goes on. Exactly these spellings are accepted; using a type outside its report family raises 8170. `sizeaxis` is lowercase only.

x-enumDescriptions.sizeaxis: Size-encoding axis for bubble charts (chart); lowercase only
x-enumDescriptions.tooltip: Extra columns surfaced in the tooltip (chart)
x-enumDescriptions.toolTip: Extra columns surfaced in the tooltip (chart)
x-enumDescriptions.data: Measure shelf (pivot); at least one required

tableName.description: Table the column belongs to. Required when the column comes from a joined (lookup) table; may be omitted for base-table columns.

operation.description: Aggregation or date grouping applied to the column. Letters only. Which values apply depends on the column data type and the shelf: see Appendix C of the Reports document. `std` is not a valid axis operation (use `stddev`); `avg` is accepted on charts only (use `average` on a pivot data shelf).

x-enumDescriptions.dmdc: Distinct count of days of month

sort.description: Sort direction for this shelf entry.

rangeSize.description: Bin width for `range` grouping on a numeric column. Must be a JSON number: a quoted string raises 8162, an array 8516.

geoRole.description: Required when operation is `geo`. Place roles apply to text columns on the X axis only; latitude/longitude to numeric columns.

AxisColumns.title: AxisColumns
AxisColumns.description: JSONArray of the drop-field configuration: which column goes on which shelf with which operation. Maximum 1000 entries.

ColumnFormat.title: ColumnFormat
ColumnFormat.description: JSONObject controlling how the values of an axis column are rendered.

type.description: Format category applied to the column values.

currencyFormat.description: Currency symbol or code shown alongside the value.

alignment.description: Horizontal alignment of the value within the cell.

thousandSeparator.description: Controls whether a thousand separator is inserted.

decimalPlaces.description: Number of decimal places to display.

decimalSeparator.description: Character used as the decimal separator.

showSymbol.description: Controls whether the currency or percentage symbol is shown.

showNegativeSign.description: Controls whether an explicit minus sign is shown for negative values.

numberingType.description: Scale suffix applied to large numbers.

unitsList.description: Custom unit suffix appended to the value.

displayLabel.description: Label override displayed in the chart legend.

dateFormat.description: Pattern used to display date values.

userLocale.description: Controls whether the viewer's locale is applied when formatting the value.

WindowFunction.title: WindowFunction
WindowFunction.description: JSONObject applying a table calculation on top of the aggregated value of a measure.

type.description: The calculation. Chart reports accept normal, runtotal, pctoftotal, difffrom, pctdifffrom, pctofprevval, hundredpctgrp and movingcalc; pivot reports accept normal, pctofrow, pctofcol, pctofparrow, pctofparcol, pctoftotal, runtotal, difffrom, pctdifffrom and pctofprevval.

baseField.description: Reference column, required by difffrom, pctdifffrom and movingcalc.

baseTable.description: Name of the table the reference column belongs to.

baseFieldPosition.description: Axis position occupied by the reference field.

baseFunction.description: Aggregation or date grouping applied to the column. Letters only. Which values apply depends on the column data type and the shelf: see Appendix C of the Reports document. `std` is not a valid axis operation (use `stddev`); `avg` is accepted on charts only (use `average` on a pivot data shelf).

x-enumDescriptions.dmdc: Distinct count of days of month

percentileVal.description: Target percentile, applicable only with the percentile operation.

MovingCalculation.title: MovingCalculation
MovingCalculation.description: JSONObject defining the moving window used by the movingAvg window function.

calculation.description: Calculation applied over the moving window.

previous.description: Number of preceding data points included in the window.

next.description: Number of following data points included in the window.

includeCurrent.description: Controls whether the current data point is part of the window.

includeNull.description: Controls whether null values are counted within the window.

MergeAxisInfo.title: MergeAxisInfo
MergeAxisInfo.description: JSONArray of Y-axis merge groups, required when isAxisMerge is true (and isAxisMerge must be true whenever this array is non-empty). Maximum 10 entries.

MergeAxisGroup.title: MergeAxisGroup
MergeAxisGroup.description: One group of y-axes merged onto a single scale.

axisIndex.description: Zero-based indexes of the Y-axis columns merged onto one scale.

ReportFilters.title: ReportFilters
ReportFilters.description: JSONArray of static filter criteria baked into the report. Viewers cannot change them. Maximum 1000 entries.

ReportFilter.title: ReportFilter
ReportFilter.description: One static criterion applied every time the report renders.

columnName.description: Name of the column the filter operates on.

columnId.description: ID of the column, as an alternative to `columnName`.

tableName.description: Name of the table the column belongs to.

tableId.description: ID of the table, as an alternative to `tableName`.

operation.description: How the column is interpreted before the criteria is applied. See Appendix D of the Reports document.

filterType.description: Shape of the criteria. Must suit the column type and operation (8167 otherwise). Matched case-insensitively.

values.description: Criteria values, as strings. The format depends on filterType: see Appendix E of the Reports document (8168 on mismatch, 8191 for malformed dates).

rankingColumn.description: Measure column that drives the rank, for ranking / rankingpct.

rankingColumnDateSubType.description: Date sub-grouping applied to the ranking reference column.

exclude.description: true excludes the listed values, false includes them. Must be a JSON boolean (8517 otherwise).

FilterValues.title: FilterValues
FilterValues.description: JSONArray of the values the filter matches on, or the ranking specification when `filterType` is ranking.

FilterWildcard.title: FilterWildcard
FilterWildcard.description: JSONObject describing a wildcard filter, applied when `filterType` is wildcard.

expression.description: How the criteria combine, referenced by 1-based index, wrapped in parentheses: "(1 AND 2 OR 3)". Without the parentheses it is rejected with 8509.

WildcardCriteria.title: WildcardCriteria
WildcardCriteria.description: JSONArray of wildcard match conditions. A maximum of 15 conditions is allowed.

FilterAdditionalDetails.title: FilterAdditionalDetails
FilterAdditionalDetails.description: JSONObject carrying extra context about where the filter originated.

isFromDashboard.description: Indicates whether the filter was pushed down from a dashboard.

fromViewId.description: ID of the dashboard or view the filter originated from.

UserFilters.title: UserFilters
UserFilters.description: JSONArray of interactive filter widgets rendered alongside the report. Maximum 1000 entries.

UserFilter.title: UserFilter
UserFilter.description: One interactive filter widget displayed to the viewer of the analysis view.

tableName.description: Name of the table the filter column belongs to.

columnName.description: Name of the column the widget filters on.

operation.description: Mandatory for date and numeric columns; ignored for text columns, which are always actual. Dates: actual, seasonal, relative, range, daterange. Numerics: the aggregate values.

compType.description: Widget type. slider is measure-only; singleSelect / multiSelect are for dimensions and dates; dateRange for the range / daterange operations. A mismatch raises 8250; a missing required compType raises 8253.

filterType.description: Criteria shape. Required for measures and for date actual / seasonal operations.

isallval.description: Whether the filter defaults to "all values". Derived from values when omitted: a non-empty values array implies false. When true, values is ignored.

values.description: Selectable / preselected values. Required when isallval is false.

defaultFilterValues.description: Values preselected on load. Must be a subset of values.

exclude.description: Defaults to false. Not allowed with the daterange operation.

behaviour.description: Applies to the select-style widgets only. Not applicable to daterange or relative operations (8008).

DefaultFilterValues.title: DefaultFilterValues
DefaultFilterValues.description: JSONArray of values the widget falls back to when the viewer clears the selection.

ViewSettings.title: ViewSettings
ViewSettings.description: JSONObject holding the layout and theme settings of a pivot report. Supplying it for a chart or summary raises 8147. Maximum serialized size 10 KB.

ViewSettingsLayout.title: ViewSettingsLayout
ViewSettingsLayout.description: JSONObject controlling the column layout of the view.

defaultWidth.description: Default column width in pixels, applied to pivot and summary tables.

ViewSettingsThemes.title: ViewSettingsThemes
ViewSettingsThemes.description: JSONObject controlling the visual theme of the view.

themeType.description: Index of the preset theme style applied to the view.

themeFontSize.description: Base font size of the view in points.

compactIndent.description: Row indentation depth applied in compact mode.

DrillActionConfig.title: DrillActionConfig
DrillActionConfig.description: JSONObject configuring up to 10 custom drill-through actions. Accepted on Create only; rejected on Update with 8542.

DrillActions.title: DrillActions
DrillActions.description: JSONArray of drill action items. A maximum of 10 actions is allowed.

DrillAction.title: DrillAction
DrillAction.description: One drill-through action invoked from a data point in the view.

id.description: Unique identifier of the action, as a long integer or a hyphenated long-integer string.

urlString.description: Target URL invoked when the action fires.

methodType.description: HTTP method used to call the target URL.

body.description: Raw request body sent with the action.

DrillActionKeyValues.title: DrillActionKeyValues
DrillActionKeyValues.description: JSONArray of key-value entries used for the headers, query parameters or form body of a drill action. Maximum serialized size 5 KB.

DrillActionKeyValue.title: DrillActionKeyValue
DrillActionKeyValue.description: One key-value entry of a drill action.

value.description: Value of the entry. Column placeholders in the format {{ColumnName}} are substituted at click time.

type.description: Whether the value is a literal or resolved from the clicked data point.

ModifiedPaths.title: ModifiedPaths
ModifiedPaths.description: JSONObject with the configuration path as key and the change marker as value, used to signal which parts of the configuration were touched. Maximum serialized size 10 KB.

<config_path>.description: Marker for the change applied at that path. NOTE: the key should be a path within the report configuration.

CreateReportConfig.title: CreateReportConfig
CreateReportConfig.description: Configuration of the report to be created. Maximum encoded size 10,000,000 characters.

baseTableName.description: Display name of the table, query table or pipeline table the report is built on.

reportType.description: The report family. Lowercase only (8509 otherwise).

title.description: Report name, unique within the workspace. Required in practice: omitting it creates an unnamed view and most callers will hit 7016 or 8051.

folderId.description: Folder to create the report in; must exist in the workspace (7362). Omitted: the default folder.

chartType.description: Required in practice when reportType is chart; ignored for pivot and summary. Matched case-insensitively; letters, digits and spaces only. Omitted or empty: the server picks BEST.

isAxisMerge.description: Merge multiple Y axes onto one shared axis.

UpdateReportConfig.title: UpdateReportConfig
UpdateReportConfig.description: Replacement configuration for an existing report. The report is rebuilt from scratch on every call: omitted filters, userFilters and description are cleared. baseTableName, drillActionConfig and modifiedPaths are not accepted (8542).

reportType.description: Must match the stored view type (8021 otherwise).

title.description: Accepted but ignored: the stored display name is kept. A report cannot be renamed through this endpoint.

description.description: Omitting it clears the existing description.

chartType.description: Required in practice when reportType is chart; ignored for pivot and summary. Matched case-insensitively; letters, digits and spaces only. Omitted or empty: the server picks BEST.

isAxisMerge.description: Merge multiple Y axes onto one shared axis.

folderId.description: Accepted by the schema, but the report cannot be moved: supplying it raises 8145. Omit it.

objId.description: Inert: the server always uses the report ID from the URL.

CreateReportResponse.title: CreateReportResponse
CreateReportResponse.description: Response returned when an analysis view is created.

summary.description: Human readable message describing the result.

CreateReportResponseData.title: CreateReportResponseData
CreateReportResponseData.description: Identifiers of the newly created analysis view.

viewId.description: ID of the newly created analysis view. Use it in the URL of later Update Analysis View and Get Report Metadata calls.

GetReportMetadataResponse.title: GetReportMetadataResponse
GetReportMetadataResponse.description: Response carrying the stored configuration of an analysis view.

summary.description: Human readable message describing the result.

GetReportMetadataResponseData.title: GetReportMetadataResponseData
GetReportMetadataResponseData.description: Wrapper holding the stored view configuration.

ReportConfigMetadata.title: ReportConfigMetadata
ReportConfigMetadata.description: The stored definition of the report as returned by Read Report Metadata. It is a summary, not a round-trippable CONFIG: folderId, settings, drillActionConfig and modifiedPaths are never returned, and several values change on the way out.

reportType.description: May be widget for widget-backed views, which Create and Update reject with 8509.

chartType.description: Present only when the stored chart and sub-chart types map back to a known name; reverse-derived, so aliases collapse.

baseTableName.description: Returned by the read, rejected by Update (8542).

ReportMetadataAxisColumns.title: ReportMetadataAxisColumns
ReportMetadataAxisColumns.description: JSONArray of the axis columns stored for the view. Only type, columnName, tableName and operation are returned; displayName, sort, rangeSize, windowFunction, format and geoRole are not.

ReportMetadataAxisColumn.title: ReportMetadataAxisColumn
ReportMetadataAxisColumn.description: One axis column as stored. type is always returned lowercase; operation and chartType are reverse-derived from storage, so aliases collapse (see Round-tripping a report).

type.description: Shelf, always lowercase. A tooltip column may be returned as group, which Create and Update reject.

x-enumDescriptions.group: Tooltip column reported as group (not accepted on write)

columnName.description: Column display name in its stored casing.

tableName.description: Always returned, even where it was omitted on write.

operation.description: Reverse-derived from storage: average/avg, absquarter/quarteryear, absmonth/monthyear, absweek/weekyear, actual/geo and variance/dc/distinctcount collapse, and all date distinct-count operations share one stored marker.

DashboardSummary.title: DashboardSummary
DashboardSummary.description: Summary of one dashboard as returned by the listing APIs.

viewId.description: ID of the dashboard. Returned as a string even though the underlying value is a long integer.

viewDesc.description: Description of the dashboard. An empty string when none is set.
examples: High-level sales KPIs for the executive team

viewType.description: Type of the view. Always Dashboard for entries returned by these APIs.

parentViewId.description: ID of the parent view, if there is one. An empty string otherwise.

folderId.description: ID of the folder that contains the dashboard.

createdTime.description: Creation timestamp of the dashboard, in epoch milliseconds.

createdBy.description: Email address of the user who created the dashboard.

lastModifiedTime.description: Timestamp of the last modification, in epoch milliseconds.

lastModifiedBy.description: Email address of the user who last modified the dashboard.

isFavorite.description: Indicates whether the requesting user has marked the dashboard as a favorite.

sharedBy.description: Email address of the user who shared the dashboard. Populated for shared entries and an empty string for owned entries.

workspaceId.description: ID of the workspace that contains the dashboard. Use it as the workspace ID in the workspace-scoped dashboard APIs.

orgId.description: ID of the organization the workspace belongs to. It corresponds to the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header value.

GetDashboardsResponse.title: GetDashboardsResponse
GetDashboardsResponse.description: Response listing every dashboard accessible to the authenticated user, split into owned and shared.

GetDashboardsResponseData.title: GetDashboardsResponseData
GetDashboardsResponseData.description: The two dashboard lists returned by Get All Dashboards.

ownedViews.viewDesc: High-level sales KPIs for the executive team

GetDashboardListResponse.title: GetDashboardListResponse
GetDashboardListResponse.description: Response carrying a single list of dashboards - owned only or shared only, depending on the endpoint.

summary.description: Human readable message describing the result.

GetDashboardListResponseData.title: GetDashboardListResponseData
GetDashboardListResponseData.description: The dashboard list returned by Get Owned Dashboards and Get Shared Dashboards.

views.viewDesc: High-level sales KPIs for the executive team

DashboardLayout.title: DashboardLayout
DashboardLayout.description: The decoded layout: a JSONObject keyed by string card IDs ("1", "2", ...), each value a card. On Create and Update it travels inside CONFIG as a JSON-encoded STRING (layout is declared as text and parsed as a nested document); Read returns it as a genuine object.

DashboardLayoutCard.title: DashboardLayoutCard
DashboardLayoutCard.description: One card placed on the 80-unit grid. The key of the entry in layout is an arbitrary string card ID; the read API renumbers cards from "1" in storage order. Rules are enforced in order: all five positional fields present (7479), correct JSON types (7486), recognised type (7485), inside the grid with width and height above 1 (7480), per-type minimum size (7512), non-empty content for non-VIEW cards (7483), VIEW resolves (8027) and is readable (7481), no overlap (7482), at most 100 cards (7484), at least one non-USERFILTERS card (9001).

type.description: Card kind; decides which further fields are required and the minimum size.

x-enumDescriptions.VIEW: Saved report; needs viewName; min 5 x 10
x-enumDescriptions.HTML: HTML block; needs content; min 1 x 5
x-enumDescriptions.TITLE: Heading; needs content; min 3 x 5
x-enumDescriptions.EMBED: External URL/iframe; needs content; min 5 x 5
x-enumDescriptions.USERFILTERS: Interactive filter panel; must span width 80; min height 1
x-enumDescriptions.DELETED: Placeholder for a removed view; optional viewId; min 5 x 10

width.description: Width in grid units. left + width must not exceed 80. USERFILTERS must be 80.

height.description: Height in grid units (per-type minimum applies).

viewName.description: VIEW cards: display name of the embedded report, matched case-insensitively.

viewId.description: DELETED cards: ID of the removed view (optional).

content.description: HTML, TITLE, PARA, IMAGE and EMBED cards: non-empty content (7483 otherwise). IMAGE: a digits-only value is a stored file ID. XSS-filtered on write.

respContent.description: DELETED cards in read responses: why the card is a placeholder. Not a write key.

DashboardCardProperties.title: DashboardCardProperties
DashboardCardProperties.description: JSONObject of card-level key/value properties. Stored on non-VIEW cards (values must be strings; htmlBgColor only as rgb(r, g, b)); on VIEW cards it is overwritten with {} on every write. Never returned by the read API.

<property_name>.description: Value of that card property. NOTE: the key should be a card property name supported for the card type.

DashboardThemes.title: DashboardThemes
DashboardThemes.description: Visual theme. Mode A, default theme: send {"default": "true"} (or "unset") and nothing else (7493 otherwise). Mode B, explicit theme: type is mandatory and selects which sub-object is required: solid needs solid.background and card.background; gradient needs gradient.background/startColor/endColor/mode and card.background/opacity/blur; image needs image.url/background and card.background/opacity/blur. Colours are #RRGGBB or #RGB only (8509).

default.description: Resets the theme to the built-in defaults. When it is "true", all other theme attributes are ignored.

type.description: Background fill style of the dashboard.

layoutType.description: Number of the preset layout theme.

card.description: Card styling. Required in mode B.

DashboardThemeSolid.title: DashboardThemeSolid
DashboardThemeSolid.description: JSONObject configuring a solid background, applied when the theme `type` is solid.

DashboardThemeGradient.title: DashboardThemeGradient
DashboardThemeGradient.description: Gradient background, applied when type is gradient. Exactly one of linear / radial must be present and must match mode (7492 / 7493 otherwise).

DashboardGradientLinear.title: DashboardGradientLinear
DashboardGradientLinear.description: JSONObject configuring a linear gradient, applied when the gradient `mode` is linear.

angle.description: Angle of the linear gradient, in degrees.

DashboardGradientRadial.title: DashboardGradientRadial
DashboardGradientRadial.description: JSONObject configuring a radial gradient, applied when the gradient `mode` is radial.

x.description: Horizontal focal point of the radial gradient.

y.description: Vertical focal point of the radial gradient.

DashboardThemeImage.title: DashboardThemeImage
DashboardThemeImage.description: JSONObject configuring an image background, applied when the theme `type` is image.

brightness.description: Brightness adjustment applied to the image.

contrast.description: Contrast adjustment applied to the image.

fitType.description: How the image fits the canvas.

family.description: Font family: letters, digits, spaces, apostrophes, hyphens; max 50.

DashboardThemeCard.title: DashboardThemeCard
DashboardThemeCard.description: JSONObject controlling the styling applied to every card on the dashboard.

blur.description: Blur radius applied behind the card.

DashboardCardBorder.title: DashboardCardBorder
DashboardCardBorder.description: JSONObject describing the border of a dashboard card.

width.description: Border width. One value is written to all four edges.

DashboardCardTextStyle.title: DashboardCardTextStyle
DashboardCardTextStyle.description: JSONObject styling the title or the description text of a dashboard card.

DashboardChartEffect.title: DashboardChartEffect
DashboardChartEffect.description: JSONObject controlling the animation effect applied to the charts on the dashboard.

apply.description: Controls whether a chart effect is applied. Mandatory whenever `chartEffect` is sent.

type.description: Forbidden when apply is 1 (7513), required when apply is 2 (7514).

DashboardPalette.title: DashboardPalette
DashboardPalette.description: Accepted but unsupported: passes schema validation and is stored, but its conditional validation is disabled in the current build. Do not depend on it.

DashboardPaletteChart.title: DashboardPaletteChart
DashboardPaletteChart.description: JSONObject naming the chart color palette.

type.description: Name of the chart color palette.

DashboardSettings.title: DashboardSettings
DashboardSettings.description: Viewer behaviour flags. Supplying a partial object writes only those keys (no merge with defaults). Boolean flags are the strings "true" / "false" as shown in the reference samples; the read API returns them in that form.

enableGlobalUF.description: Controls whether a global user filter is applied across all cards.

enableGlobalValueUF.description: Controls whether the global value based user filter is enabled.

smartAlignCharts.description: Controls whether charts are auto-aligned to the grid.

showContextualOptions.description: Controls whether contextual chart options are shown to viewers.

allowEmbedInsights.description: Controls whether AI insights can be embedded in the dashboard.

enableSortMenu.description: Controls whether sort options are shown in viewer mode.

reportAsFilter.description: Controls whether charts can act as filters for the other charts on the dashboard.

hideColumnOptions.description: Controls whether column level options are hidden in viewer mode.

allowVUD.description: Controls whether view, update and delete interactions are allowed.

allowInsights.description: Controls whether AI powered insights are enabled.

fitToWidth.description: Controls whether the dashboard is stretched to fill the browser width.

layoutType.description: Target page layout. Default web. mobile is not a valid value.

layoutWidth.description: Fixed layout width in pixels. Default "1279".

allowDrillDown.description: Controls whether drill-down on chart data points is enabled.

applyImmediateUF.description: Controls whether user filter values are applied immediately, without a submit button.

timeSlicer.description: Controls whether the time-slicer user filter component is enabled.

mapSync.description: Controls whether the map view is synchronized across the dashboard cards.

allowAllExport.description: Alias of allowExport used as a single master switch. Reads back as allowExport.

DashboardAllowExport.title: DashboardAllowExport
DashboardAllowExport.description: Per-format export control. Any sub-key you omit is stored as "false".

csv.description: Controls whether CSV export is allowed.

excel.description: Controls whether Excel export is allowed.

html.description: Controls whether HTML export is allowed.

image.description: Controls whether image export is allowed.

pdf.description: Controls whether PDF export is allowed.

zohoSheet.description: Controls whether export to Zoho Sheet is allowed.

CreateDashboardConfig.title: CreateDashboardConfig
CreateDashboardConfig.description: Configuration of the dashboard to be created. Maximum encoded size 5,000,000 characters. Only displayName, description, layout, themes, settings and layoutType are accepted (8542 otherwise).

displayName.description: Name of the dashboard, unique within the workspace (7111).

layout.description: The card layout as a JSON-encoded string whose decoded form is DashboardLayout. Sending a nested object instead of a string is rejected by schema validation. Max 1,000,000 characters.

layoutType.description: 1-4 generate a 1/2/3/4-column layout from the view names and content strings in layout, discarding the supplied geometry. Omitted or 0 keeps the layout as submitted. Values outside 1-4 are rejected with 8509.

UpdateDashboardConfig.title: UpdateDashboardConfig
UpdateDashboardConfig.description: Replacement configuration for an existing dashboard. Only layout, themes, settings and layoutType are accepted; displayName and description raise 8542. Each supplied section is deleted and rewritten in full; an omitted section is left untouched. Maximum encoded size 5,000,000 characters.

layout.description: The card layout as a JSON-encoded string whose decoded form is DashboardLayout. Sending a nested object instead of a string is rejected by schema validation. Max 1,000,000 characters.

layoutType.description: Triggers auto-layout generation for the supplied layout.

GetDashboardMetadataConfig.title: GetDashboardMetadataConfig
GetDashboardMetadataConfig.description: Configuration controlling which sections of the dashboard are returned.

include.description: Which section to return. Exactly one value; comma-separated lists are not accepted (8509). Default all.

x-enumDescriptions.all: Identity fields and all three sections

CreateDashboardResponse.title: CreateDashboardResponse
CreateDashboardResponse.description: Response returned when a dashboard is created.

summary.description: Human readable message describing the result.

CreateDashboardResponseData.title: CreateDashboardResponseData
CreateDashboardResponseData.description: Identifiers of the newly created dashboard.

dashboardId.description: ID of the newly created dashboard. It is the same value returned as objId by Get Dashboard Metadata and as viewId by the listing APIs.

displayName.description: Display name of the newly created dashboard, as stored.

GetDashboardMetadataResponse.title: GetDashboardMetadataResponse
GetDashboardMetadataResponse.description: Response carrying the stored configuration of a dashboard.

summary.description: Human readable message describing the result.

GetDashboardMetadataResponseData.title: GetDashboardMetadataResponseData
GetDashboardMetadataResponseData.description: Wrapper holding the stored dashboard configuration.

DashboardConfigMetadata.title: DashboardConfigMetadata
DashboardConfigMetadata.description: The stored dashboard configuration as returned by Read Dashboard Metadata. layout is returned as a genuine nested object (it is written as a string); theme numbers come back as strings; card IDs are renumbered; layoutType, card properties and image_properties are never returned. With include set to a single section, only that section is present.

objId.description: ID of the dashboard. It can be used directly as the dashboard ID in the Update Dashboard URL.

description.description: Description of the dashboard. An empty string when none is set.

DashboardThemesMetadata.title: DashboardThemesMetadata
DashboardThemesMetadata.description: JSONObject holding the visual theme of the dashboard. Sending `default` as "true" resets the theme and causes every other attribute here to be ignored. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

default.description: Resets the theme to the built-in defaults. When it is "true", all other theme attributes are ignored.

type.description: Background fill style of the dashboard.

layoutType.description: Number of the preset layout theme. Returned as a string between "1" and "6".

DashboardThemeGradientMetadata.title: DashboardThemeGradientMetadata
DashboardThemeGradientMetadata.description: JSONObject configuring a gradient background, applied when the theme `type` is gradient. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

background.description: Fallback background color, as a hex code.

startColor.description: Color the gradient starts from, as a hex code.

endColor.description: Color the gradient ends at, as a hex code.

DashboardGradientLinearMetadata.title: DashboardGradientLinearMetadata
DashboardGradientLinearMetadata.description: JSONObject configuring a linear gradient, applied when the gradient `mode` is linear. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

angle.description: Angle of the linear gradient, in degrees. Returned as a string between "-270" and "270".

DashboardGradientRadialMetadata.title: DashboardGradientRadialMetadata
DashboardGradientRadialMetadata.description: JSONObject configuring a radial gradient, applied when the gradient `mode` is radial. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

x.description: Horizontal focal point of the radial gradient. Returned as a string between "0" and "180".

y.description: Vertical focal point of the radial gradient. Returned as a string between "0" and "180".

DashboardThemeImageMetadata.title: DashboardThemeImageMetadata
DashboardThemeImageMetadata.description: JSONObject configuring an image background, applied when the theme `type` is image. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

background.description: Fallback color rendered behind the image, as a hex code.

brightness.description: Brightness adjustment applied to the image. Returned as a string between "-100" and "100".

contrast.description: Contrast adjustment applied to the image. Returned as a string between "-100" and "100".

transparency.description: Transparency of the image as a percentage, sent as a string between "0" and "100".

flip.description: Controls whether the image is flipped.

fitType.description: Strategy used to fit the image to the dashboard.

DashboardFontMetadata.title: DashboardFontMetadata
DashboardFontMetadata.description: JSONObject describing a font configuration. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

color.description: Font color, as a hex code.

size.description: Font size in points. Returned as a string between "7" and "24".

DashboardThemeCardMetadata.title: DashboardThemeCardMetadata
DashboardThemeCardMetadata.description: JSONObject controlling the styling applied to every card on the dashboard. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

background.description: Background color of the card, as a hex code.

opacity.description: Opacity of the card background. Returned as a string between "0" and "1".

blur.description: Blur radius applied behind the card. Returned as a string between "0" and "50".

radius.description: Corner radius of the card. Returned as a string between "0" and "20".

margin.description: Outer margin of the card. Returned as a string between "0" and "10".

shadow.description: Shadow style applied to the card. Returned as a string.

DashboardCardTextStyleMetadata.title: DashboardCardTextStyleMetadata
DashboardCardTextStyleMetadata.description: JSONObject styling the title or the description text of a dashboard card. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

DashboardChartEffectMetadata.title: DashboardChartEffectMetadata
DashboardChartEffectMetadata.description: JSONObject controlling the animation effect applied to the charts on the dashboard. Every scalar in this object is returned as a string.

apply.description: Controls whether a chart effect is applied. Mandatory whenever `chartEffect` is sent. Returned as a string.

type.description: Effect variant applied when `apply` is 2. Returned as a string.

ReportMetadataFilter.title: ReportMetadataFilter
ReportMetadataFilter.description: One static filter as stored. wildcard, rankingColumn, rankingColumnDateSubType and additionalDetails are not returned; values are reconstructed by splitting the stored criteria on commas.

operation.description: Date filters created with actual, range or daterange may be returned as any of the three.

filterType.description: Several input values collapse on read, e.g. absmonth / monthyear / month.

ReportMetadataFilters.title: ReportMetadataFilters
ReportMetadataFilters.description: JSONArray of the static filters as stored.

ReportMetadataUserFilter.title: ReportMetadataUserFilter
ReportMetadataUserFilter.description: One user filter as stored. Only tableName, columnName and operation are returned; for date columns operation carries a filterType-shaped value that is not valid on write (8166).

ReportMetadataUserFilters.title: ReportMetadataUserFilters
ReportMetadataUserFilters.description: JSONArray of the user filters as stored, reduced to three keys.
